biography: A highly professional sales executive driven by exceeding targets with over 12 years’ experience in Solution Selling and Account Management starting with IBM UK Ltd and now with Pulsant, the cloud computing, managed hosting and colocation expert. I have been successful in selling a broad range of products and services to customers including Cloud, Managed IT Infrastructure Services, Project and Implementation Services, various Software and Hardware solutions as well as Security and Network solutions. My customers operate in a broad range of industries including Financial Services, Food and Drink, Life Sciences, Construction, Property, Nuclear Generation and Facilities Management. I am very adaptable to working across these different industries and enjoy discussing the varied business issues and challenges faced by my clients. Through incisive questioning I find out what people do and want, and change how companies work using the technologies in my portfolio. I build trust based relationships with my clients so they choose to buy what I have to sell.
